Our objectives are to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements as a whole are free from
materialmisstatement, whether due to fraud or error, and to issue an auditors report that includes our opinion.

alwaysdetect a material misstatement when it exists. Misstatements can arise from fraud or error and are considered
material if,individually or in the aggregate, they could reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions of users
taken onthe basis of these financial statements.As a part of audit in accordance with standards on auditing, we exercise
professionaljudgement and maintain professional scepticism throughout the audit. We also: 1.Identify and assess the risks of
materialmisstatement of the financial statements, whether due to fraud or error, design and perform audit procedures
responsive tothose risks, and obtain audit evidence that is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for our opinion. The
risk of notdetecting a material misstatement resulting from fraud is higher than for one resulting from error, as fraud may

understanding of internal control relevant to the audit in order to design audit procedures that are appropriatein the
